messages:
Alex Kim: dropping a compact mock for the rollout timeline slider + version markers. focusing on canary allocation display, keyboard affordances, and microcopy. image: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/rollout-slider-compact.png
Marta Varga: nice layout. quick: the small markers at 0/50/100 have insufficient contrast when the timeline bg is light gray. also the label 'Canary traffic' might confuse product folks. 'Canary allocation' reads better imo.
Jon Park: tech note: the markers are svg paths with currentColor. Raising their stroke color to #3b3b3b fixes contrast. Thumb hit target currently 14px, we should bump to 18-20px for touch.
a11y-bot: accessibility scan: marker contrast ratio = 2.5:1 (FAIL). interactive control sizes: 14px (FAIL, recommend >= 18px).
Alex Kim: updated mock with darker markers and larger thumb. Added keyboard hints: Left/Right = 1%, Shift+Left/Right = 10%. Proposed ARIA: role="slider" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="10" aria-label="Canary allocation percentage".
Marta Varga: good. microcopy suggestion: show the percentage inline when >0, like 'Canary allocation — 10%'. Also for complex projects we sometimes use 'Split' in UI; maybe A/B test 'Allocation' vs 'Split' for clarity.
Jon Park: implementing dual-ring focus: inner white 2px + outer blue 4px to keep contrast on dark tracks. Will push a quick staging demo.
Sarah Lee: I'll add the A/B test to the experiments board (2-week run). Metrics: first-time completion of rollout flow, and help center opens for rollout. Also log keyboard users vs mouse.
Alex Kim: thanks team. I'll finalize copy to 'Canary allocation' and coordinate with Docs for consistency. Reopening if staging demo shows regressions.
_note: Slack thread for design review: rollout slider, accessibility & copy. No title per agents.md.
